purpose: Machine-readable editorial policy for ranking, radar, auto-publish and original-story selection. Canonical writing and story-quality standard: docs/EDITORIAL_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md.

preferredSourceMix: regional/local reporting as corroboration or background

homepageDiversity.purpose: Rerank after base scoring so visible homepage clusters prefer different categories and subjects. Do not replace interest/relevance ranking or force weak stories.

originalStory.cadence: At least one original-story candidate every daily news watch. Publish nothing when reporting is not strong enough.

critical: GO or Lakeshore West service suspended, cancelled, stopped or bus-replaced
Skyway fully closed or all lanes closed on the bridge
QEW or 403 mainline complete closure affecting Burlington travel
Tornado warning, evacuation or a major Burlington emergency
Widespread power emergency with immediate local risk
notCritical: Moderate or heavy traffic without a mainline closure

breakingNow.timeRule: Use the source publication time or a verified substantive update time. Never present crawler, build, discovery or generation time as the news event/update time.

writing.title: clear + curiosity-driven
writing.deck: one sentence by default, 12-22 words, hard maximum 30; two very short sentences only if needed; add one verified fact, tension or reason to continue; do not summarize the article, repeat the headline, or resolve the headline's central question/conflict
answerReaderQuestions: what the reader should understand differently now
endingCheck: Has the article answered its original question?
What is the most interesting fact or consequence created by that answer?
Is there one specific unresolved question?
Is there a concrete next event or data point?
What should a Burlington reader understand differently now?
writing.endingRule: The final paragraph must answer at least one of endingCheck items 2-5. Reject generic endings.
writing.ifSourceDoesNotDisclose: Say that clearly instead of writing around the hole.
avoid: listicle framing unless the subject requires a list
auto-publishing weak or unclear stories for volume
long numeric lists in prose when a visual can carry the comparison
the story is what happens next
the interesting question is what comes next
